text: When too much hits you at once, your nervous system can become flooded, and nothing makes sense, even as the brain still tries to derive meanings that might create unhelpful feedback loops. Underlying those interpretations are factors like the dose of what drug(s) you took and how your body handles them, or how hard you pushed a practice. Old painful memories could have been triggered, or you may have gone in with a fearful or unloving mindset, or the setting or people around you could have fed into it. Be kind to yourself or to whoever's going through it, because blaming anyone only makes it heavier.
reader: someone who had, or is sitting with, an overwhelming trip, from a drug or from a practice, wondering what a bad trip is and why it happened
